description: This file defines classes and interfaces for managing LXC containers, including network interface iteration, container configuration, and container administration within the Thunder project.

classes.name: LXCNetworkInterfaceIterator
classes.description: Iterator for network interfaces within an LXC container.

classes.name: LXCContainer
classes.description: Represents an LXC container with management capabilities.

classes.name: LXCContainer::Config
classes.description: Container configuration class with nested ConfigItem class.

classes.name: LXCContainer::Config::ConfigItem
classes.description: Configuration key-value pair for container settings.

classes.name: LXCContainerAdministrator
classes.description: Manages creation and lifecycle of LXC containers.

methods.name: Next
methods.description: Advances the network interface iterator to the next interface.

methods.name: Previous
methods.description: Moves the network interface iterator to the previous interface.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the iterator to a specific position.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the current iterator position is valid.

methods.name: Index
methods.description: Returns the current index of the iterator.

methods.name: Count
methods.description: Returns the total number of interfaces.

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Returns the name of the network interface.

methods.name: NumAddresses
methods.description: Returns the number of addresses associated with the interface.

methods.name: Address
methods.description: Returns the address at a given index.

methods.name: Type
methods.description: Returns the container type (LXC).

methods.name: Id
methods.description: Returns the container's identifier.

methods.name: Pid
methods.description: Returns the process ID of the container.

methods.name: Memory
methods.description: Returns memory information of the container.

methods.name: ProcessorInfo
methods.description: Returns processor information of the container.

methods.name: NetworkInterfaces
methods.description: Returns an iterator over network interfaces.

methods.name: IsRunning
methods.description: Checks if the container is running.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Starts the container with specified command and parameters.

methods.name: Stop
methods.description: Stops the container with a timeout.

methods.name: InheritRequestedEnvironment
methods.description: Inherits environment variables for the container.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the container administrator with configuration.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Deinitializes the container administrator.

methods.name: Container
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a container instance.

methods.name: Logging
methods.description: Sets up logging for container management.
